title: Effects of Probiotics on Skin Health in Healthy Women
official: A Randomised, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Clinical Investigation to Evaluate the Effects of an Oral Probiotic Supplement in Healthy Adult Women With Clinically Dry to Very Dry Facial Skin.
summary: The effect of probiotics on skin health in healthy women with dry to very dry facial skin.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female, of self-reported Caucasian ethnicity, aged 35 to 45 years at the time of informed consent
* Fitzpatrick skin type II-IV
* Mean MoistureMeterSC value of ≤30 obtained at the Baseline Visit before randomisation
* Generally healthy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Significant facial dermatological condition that may interfere with study assessments
* Uncontrolled or clinically significant medical condition that may compromise participant safety or interpretation of study outcomes
* Known allergy, intolerance or hypersensitivity to any active ingredient, excipient or component of the study product or placebo
* Use of prohibited medications, nutritional supplements or cosmetic/dermatological procedures
* Current participation in another interventional clinical study, or participation in another interventional study within the previous 30 days.
* Lifestyle, skincare or cosmetic factors likely to interfere with study assessments or interfere with instrumental or imaging assessment
* Pregnant, breastfeeding or planning pregnancy during the study period.
